facts.text: Serve the snacks when Viktor Drago runs the dawn streets of Kyiv with his father watching.
facts.why: The plot has Viktor training in Ukraine under Ivan and put through torturous physical tests. No source or transcript names Kyiv or shows dawn runs.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Ivan puts Viktor through his training in Ukraine.

facts.why: In the plot Adonis proposes to Bianca after winning the WBC title, before she suggests moving to Los Angeles. The proposal is not in LA.

facts.text: Adonis has a ring in his pocket and a speech he can't get out
facts.why: In the film Adonis rehearses a proposal speech with a recorder and fumbles it before asking Bianca. No ring in his pocket is mentioned.
facts.fix: Adonis rehearses a proposal speech he can't quite get out

facts.why: The plot has Rocky and Little Duke retraining Adonis in a decrepit spot in the California desert. Neither the plot, the transcript nor the quotes name it The Pit.
Same as the cue. Ukraine is in the film, but Kyiv and dawn runs are not in any source I could open.
facts.fix: Viktor training under Ivan back in Ukraine

facts.text: Ask the desk about Swinging the sledgehammer in the desert.
facts.why: The desert retraining is in the film (Rocky says the work in the desert paid off), but no sledgehammer scene is in the transcript or plot.
facts.fix: Ask the desk about Adonis retraining in the desert.

vibe.verdict: A desert postcard that gets the Dragos and Little Duke right, but it leans on details no source confirms and has little from the fight itself.
